easy_fields.description: SWE-rebench is a public dataset comprising over 21,000 interactive Python-based Software Engineering (SWE) tasks, constructed using a novel, automated, and scalable pipeline to continuously extract real-world interactive SWE tasks from diverse GitHub repositories. It is designed for reinforcement learning of SWE agents at scale and provides a contamination-free benchmark for agentic software engineering.
